# openCypher TCK — Full-Corpus Parser Baseline

*Auto-generated by `cargo test -p cypher-tck --features full-tck` (equivalent: `cargo xtask tck-baseline`).  Do not hand-edit.*

This file records the rolling parser-acceptance rate of the
`cypher-db` front-end against the vendored openCypher TCK corpus
under `crates/cypher-tck/tck/full/` (see `VENDORED.md` for the
pinned upstream revision).  Every Scenario Outline is expanded
against its `Examples:` table, so the counts below are
per-example, not per-outline.

"Accepted" means the parser emits zero syntax errors for the
query extracted from the scenario's `When executing query:`
step; it does **not** yet assert that the query's runtime result
matches the TCK's `Then` expectations (the frontend does no
execution, spec §1.3 N1).  Scenarios whose expected outcome is
`Expected::Error` are still untriaged (`Expected::Ignored`), so
acceptance is not yet equivalent to pass-rate.

| Feature files scanned | **220** |
| Scenario cases (outline rows expanded) | **1339** |
| Accepted by parser | **1086** (81.1 %) |

## Next steps

- Triage scenarios one area at a time by classifying their
`Expected` outcome (`Supported` / `Error`).  Once triaged,
`accepted` becomes directly comparable to `expected`.
- Gate regressions on this number in CI once a sub-area
stabilises at 100 %.
